dedupe_keys.name: bbsr dataset kommunale waermeplanung in deutschland status of municipal heat plans by municipality as of 31 december 2025

description: This BBSR dataset shows the status of municipal heat planning in Germany at municipality level, with a research cut-off of 31 December 2025, published on 31 December 2025 and last changed on 3 June 2026. The data rest on continuing internet research and on federal and state funding data. The Heat Planning Act took effect on 1 January 2024 and requires states to ensure full coverage, with municipalities above 100,000 inhabitants due by 30 June 2026 and smaller ones by 30 June 2028. The page reports that by the end of 2025, 1,359 municipalities, about 13 percent, had completed a heat plan, up from 488 in May 2025, that another 5,157 municipalities, almost 48 percent, had started one, and that 638 plans had been published. Access: free, with the licence Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 shown on the page; the page is in German and the file format was not stated on the part read. Coverage is all German municipalities. Caveats: the status comes from desk research and funding data, so unlisted plans may be missed. It suits capacity planning studies of heat network and heat supply transition, and relates to the NRW municipal heat planning data record catalogued here.
